scope: R10 source, real runtime CPU skin, numerical tests and offline original-colour renders. No browser automation or device performance measurement.

independent.scope: Independent numerical CPU/NullEngine review against the actual packed approved R8 rig and live game update/pose/contact pipeline. This report does not establish visual animation quality, mobile FPS, heat, GPU or physical-input feel.

baseline.note: Baseline attention measured actual head +Y, unlike earlier actor-yaw-only assertions. Baseline foot-low-height observations are diagnostics and are not used as planted-foot pass/fail evidence.

originalV01Regression.note: Executed before 0.2 final calibration. The final 0.2 suite also asserts unchanged original code/config/model/dependency hashes and original twelve raw sampled poses.

autonomousContact.sampling: Five actions × min/preferred/max/outside-approach starts × 30/60Hz × .5/1/2 attack speed. Each starts the actual positioning brain, not startAction.

actualHeadAndCenteredOrbit.conditions: Both genuinely authored left/right steps, 3m/5m radii, stationary/moving player center (.12m/s lateral plus .2m slow depth oscillation).
actualHeadAndCenteredOrbit.stancePolicy: Named diagonal phases [0,.45] and [.45,.9] source seconds, left mirrored. First .3 wall seconds excluded before selecting a reference anchor; no stance reference is carried from the transition blend.

firstStepTransition.scope: Actual standing watch settled before the step. Initial support pair is compared with its actual world anchor before the first root motion; all blend frames included, no .3-second exclusion. Both phases must cover all .9 source seconds. The later half-cycle is a new support episode and is not compared with the first half entry anchors.

boundedMatrixRefresh.test: support and attention refresh only cached affected branches with bounded matrix work and identical poses
boundedMatrixRefresh.reference: The previous full-rig refresh is substituted into the same actual planted-foot and head-attention correction, then compared against the optimized path for every animator node world position and local rotation.
boundedMatrixRefresh.dirtyVisitBound: Positive and no greater than the complete actor rig node count for two support legs plus both attention joints.
boundedMatrixRefresh.limitation: This measures CPU scene-matrix work and exact sampled corrected poses, not device FPS or GPU performance.

hpPhase.note: 450 HP total hits include an unfinished final bout; completed bout sizes use only finished bouts.

checks.preservation: All original twelve raw source sampler/carrier poses, original code/config/model/dependencies, strict R9 source/moving keys and standing shapes, new R10 local attachment lengths against approved bind nodes, fixed scaling, eighteen actor-local clip targets with twelve unchanged shared-template clips.
checks.fourMapResources: Village, great plains, monster forest and witch cave: 1/5/10/20 actors, independent skeletons/morph state/targets, shared geometry, three warm repeats, cancellation/retry and original 0.1 lifetime checks.

measuredLimits: The preserved imported R8 run includes one initial 1/30-second hold and a native .600000024-second range. The 0.2 runtime skips that initial hold only: the independent test measures actual source-time wraps and the report records the resulting cycle and sampled wall periods. The original 0.1 sampler and asset remain unchanged.
Numbers for named foot anchors prove world-space support in the sampled windows; visual leg-shape and gait quality require the separate runtime-skinned render review.
Forced fourteen-second continuous circles are a stress scenario. Normal encounter stalking uses shorter finite bouts.

regression.scope: Node/NullEngine actual-rig 3D attention, complete orbit entry/foot plant, autonomous contact, feral behavior, four-map summon/resource lifecycle, preserved0.1 and shared combat regressions. No browser automation. DeviceFPS/heat/GPU and visual approval are not measured.

deformation.scope: New R10 authored motion at 60Hz on original R8 evaluated mesh; full original 4K renders reviewed separately

manifest.reviewScope: Offline Blender 4.5.14 original packed 4096x4096 colour with source metre grid and 1.6m-world warrior target at game scale2.5. Actual game contact, radial warping and real-device performance are separately verified by runtime integration.
manifest.jointCollarScope: Fixed bones and rigid muscle cores do not mean zero deformation of the interpolated joint collars; local edge strain is reported independently in deformation-validation.json. Tiny source edges amplify maximum strain ratios. The unchanged narrow collar weights show firm angular elbow/hock bends in closeup.
manifest.mirroring: Left uses reflected arc, opposite torso/neck/tail rotations and swapped full diagonal leg phases, solved independently with its own unchanged asymmetric bind lengths. It never mirrors root alone or copies opposite-side local translations.
